SELECT t.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quality_template_metric tm WHERE tm.template_id = t.id) AS metric_count FROM quality_template t WHERE t.is_deleted = 0
AND t.template_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{templateName}, '%')
AND t.status = #{status} ORDER BY t.id DESC
SELECT * FROM quality_template WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quality_template (template_code, template_name, applicable_scene, remark, status, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{templateCode}, #{templateName}, #{applicableScene}, #{remark}, #{status}, NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE quality_template SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT template_code FROM quality_template ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
